deployments_detail.use: GI Genius intelligent endoscopy module: AI computer-aided polyp detection during colonoscopy in real time. First FDA de novo cleared (2021) AI system for colonoscopy; deployed commercially and used clinically worldwide. [Medtronic (with Cosmo Intelligent Medical Devices); NVIDIA Holoscan/IGX for AI Access platform]

AccuRhythm AI algorithms for LINQ II insertable cardiac monitor: deep-learning algorithms applied to CareLink-network ECG data to remove false atrial fibrillation and false pause alerts. Deployed/FDA cleared and in clinical use. [Medtronic]
deployments_detail.value: AF false alert reduction improved to beyond prior 74.1% reduction

deployments_detail.use: Touch Surgery Enterprise: AI-powered surgical video management and analytics platform for the OR that automatically captures, annotates, and anonymizes procedural video (RedactOR AI) for surgeon review. Commercially deployed. [Medtronic (Digital Surgery)]

Touch Surgery Aide compute platform with Instrument Exit Point (IEP): first real-time AI application for the Hugo robotic-assisted surgery system, using computer vision to alert surgeons when instruments leave the visible field. IEP FDA cleared. [Medtronic; NVIDIA (Holoscan, CUDA, TensorRT)]

Sugar.IQ smart diabetes assistant app: AI (IBM Watson Health) that analyzes CGM/Guardian Connect data to surface glucose patterns and predict low-glucose events (IQcast). Commercially available/deployed. [Medtronic with IBM Watson Health]
deployments_detail.value: Guardian Connect + Sugar.IQ users gained ~1 additional hour/day in target glycemic range (real-world study)

deployments_detail.use: BrainSense Adaptive deep brain stimulation (Percept neurostimulators): world's first closed-loop adaptive DBS that senses patient brain signals and automatically adjusts stimulation for Parkinson's. FDA approved and available to patients. [Medtronic]

Tempus AI-driven EHR notifications (ALERT trial) to detect valvular heart disease care gaps and prompt clinician evaluation/referral for TAVR. Evaluated in a randomized trial; being deployed with Tempus. [Tempus AI]
deployments_detail.value: AI-enabled electronic care notifications 27% more effective than usual care at notifying clinicians

deployments_detail.use: GI Genius AI computer-aided colon polyp detection (first FDA-authorized; reduces missed polyps up to ~50%) + Touch Surgery

Medtronic-NVIDIA collaboration to build an AI platform for medical devices, integrating NVIDIA Holoscan (real-time AI computing) and IGX edge hardware into Medtronic devices starting with GI Genius / endoscopy. [NVIDIA (Holoscan, IGX)]

Everstream Analytics AI/NLP + graph/entity-resolution used by Medtronic Global Operations & Supply Chain to map multi-tier supplier networks and monitor supply-chain risk (discovered 13,876 tier-four suppliers). Deployed for supply-chain resilience. [Everstream Analytics]

Teneo agentic AI contact-center automation across voice and digital channels: RAG on approved content plus LLMs handling patient/clinician support, device troubleshooting, and field-rep workflows across 10+ business units and 60+ contact centers. In production. [Teneo.ai]
deployments_detail.value: $6M saved, 36,000 agent hours saved, 1.05M calls handled; cost per contact reduced from $25.96 to under $12 in Cardiovascular Group; 13 agents live

deployments_detail.use: AI/analytics inside Salesforce CRM used by market-development and sales teams to identify where eligible patients are located, optimize sales-team deployment, and detect care-pathway bottlenecks (e.g., heart-failure referral gaps). [Salesforce CRM]
